The code is just giving you the pod phase. That seems to be "Failed" when a pod cannot be scheduled. If that is misleading, then we need a different pod phase for this particular case? Probably not possible without an API break.

What could be enhanced is the failure message. Including a dump of the full pod might have been useful:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/f99638d315a290801ccc3c7257c556ff1bf42051/test/e2e/network/hostport.go#L218-L220

I need to check how that is currently implemented. Adding the pod struct should be doable.

Even better is including pod events. That is more work because the information might not be accessible at the time when a timeout is detected (apiserver down!), so it would have to be collected beforehand. I have an idea, but haven't had the time to implement it.

@pohly no big deal, I just wanted to bring your attention, since you put a lot of thoughts on this, not changing phases or apis, just how to improve the log message , but once you click the information is there, so it is ok
